method: Treatment received cm wiki excerpt output (title + intro + top H2 sections) as a file; control and full-page medians are the same-task results from the production wiki A/B. Excerpt runs are N=1.

core.conclusion: Excerpt is worse than control and worse than the full page on this broad task; the page has no dedicated compaction/retry section, so section selection adds context without enough navigation value.

providers.conclusion: Excerpt beats control by -48.1% tokens and beats the full page on tokens and wall time.

storage.conclusion: Excerpt beats control by -61.2% tokens and cuts tool uses versus both control and full page; token count is slightly above the full-page median but wall time is lower.

excerpt_sections: Failure and recovery: retry, overflow, compaction
core_keyflows.conclusion: Routing the same question to key-flows instead of the core module page makes the excerpt useful.

modes.conclusion: Excerpt worse than direct source reading on this narrow task; full page was better.

extensions.conclusion: Excerpt much worse; the selected generic sections added context without replacing exploration. Full page was better.

auth.conclusion: Small task: direct source reading beats both full page and excerpt.

tui.conclusion: Large task with a dedicated flow section: excerpt is the best format; full page still beats control on tools but not tokens/wall.

summary: The format depends on task size and page structure. Direct source is best on small tasks (auth). Full page is the robust default for medium/large module pages (positive on core/providers/storage/modes/extensions, negative on auth/tui). Section excerpt wins when the page has a dedicated section matching the query (providers, storage, key-flows core, tui); it loses on generic sections (modes, extensions) and small tasks (auth).
